h1: Custom 40 Stem Highlighters for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 40 stem highlighters in bulk for your team. Perfect for offices and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Ordering a 40-stem highlighter set gives you enough stock for a mid-sized team or multiple departments without the per-unit cost of smaller packs. These bulk packs work well for office supply kits, new hire welcome packages, or trade show giveaways where you want recipients to have a full set of colors. Decoration options like pad printing or laser engraving keep your logo visible on each barrel, and you can choose from assorted neon or classic shades to match your brand palette.
heroAltText: Bulk custom 40 stem highlighters in assorted neon colors with company logo, ideal for office supply kits and corporate giveaways.
